scripts.copydeps: mkdir -p static/fonts && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/* static/fonts/ && cp public/* static/
scripts.dev: yarn run copydeps && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --watch=forever --outfile=static/bundle.js & sass --watch src:static/css &
scripts.build: yarn run copydeps && sass src:static/css && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --minify --outfile=static/bundle.js
